007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies;
012
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Collections;
015import java.util.List;
016
017/**
018 * Attributes used to create or update a Select AI Agent task.
019 * <p>
020 * Values are serialized with the snake-case names expected by
021 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT}. Lists are copied into immutable snapshots.
022 * The SDK preserves nullable optional values and delegates semantic validation,
023 * including relationships to tools and other tasks, to the database.
024 *
025 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateTaskSample.html">
026 *      CreateTaskSample source</a>
027 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetTaskAttributesSample.html">
028 *      SetTaskAttributesSample source</a>
029 * @since 1.1.0
030 */
031public final class TaskAttributes {
032    /** Configured once and never mutated; shared across attribute serializations. */
033    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper()
034            .setPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
035            .setDefaultPropertyInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
036
037    /** Task instruction sent to the model. */
038    private final String instruction;
039    /** Tool names available to the task. */
040    private final List<String> tools;
041    /** Upstream task names used as input. */
042    private final List<String> input;
043    /** Whether this task can request human input. */
044    private final Boolean enableHumanTool;
045
046    private TaskAttributes(Builder builder) {
047        this.instruction = builder.instruction;
048        this.tools = builder.tools == null ? null : List.copyOf(builder.tools);
049        this.input = builder.input == null ? null : List.copyOf(builder.input);
050        this.enableHumanTool = builder.enableHumanTool;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * Returns the task instruction.
055     *
056     * @return task instruction, or {@code null} when unset
057     */
058    public String getInstruction() {
059        return instruction;
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Returns configured tool names.
064     *
065     * @return immutable tool names, or {@code null} when unset
066     */
067    public List<String> getTools() {
068        return tools == null ? null : Collections.unmodifiableList(tools);
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Returns configured upstream task inputs.
073     *
074     * @return immutable upstream task names, or {@code null} when unset
075     */
076    public List<String> getInput() {
077        return input == null ? null : Collections.unmodifiableList(input);
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * Returns whether human-tool use is enabled.
082     *
083     * @return whether human-tool use is enabled, or {@code null} when unset
084     */
085    public Boolean getEnableHumanTool() {
086        return enableHumanTool;
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * Creates a builder for task attributes.
091     *
092     * @return mutable builder for task attributes
093     */
094    public static Builder builder() {
095        return new Builder();
096    }
097
098    /**
099     * Serializes attributes using the snake-case names expected by
100     * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT}.
101     *
102     * @return JSON object containing non-null attributes
103     * @throws IllegalStateException when the attributes cannot be serialized
104     */
105    public String toJson() {
106        try {
107            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(this);
108        } catch (Exception e) {
109            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize TaskAttributes", e);
110        }
111    }
112
113    /** Builder for {@link TaskAttributes}. */
114    public static final class Builder {
115        /** Task instruction sent to the model. */
116        private String instruction;
117        /** Tool names available to the task. */
118        private List<String> tools;
119        /** Upstream task names used as input. */
120        private List<String> input;
121        /** Whether human-tool use is enabled. */
122        private Boolean enableHumanTool;
123
124        /**
125         * Sets the task instruction.
126         *
127         * @param instruction task instruction
128         * @return this builder
129         */
130        public Builder instruction(String instruction) {
131            this.instruction = instruction;
132            return this;
133        }
134
135        /**
136         * Sets the names of tools available to the task.
137         *
138         * @param tools tool names; the list is copied by the builder
139         * @return this builder
140         */
141        public Builder tools(List<String> tools) {
142            this.tools = tools == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(tools);
143            return this;
144        }
145
146        /**
147         * Sets upstream task names used as input.
148         *
149         * @param input upstream task names; the list is copied by the builder
150         * @return this builder
151         */
152        public Builder input(List<String> input) {
153            this.input = input == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(input);
154            return this;
155        }
156
157        /**
158         * Sets whether this task can request human input.
159         *
160         * @param enableHumanTool whether human-tool requests are enabled
161         * @return this builder
162         */
163        public Builder enableHumanTool(Boolean enableHumanTool) {
164            this.enableHumanTool = enableHumanTool;
165            return this;
166        }
167
168        /** Builds immutable task attributes. */
169        public TaskAttributes build() {
170            return new TaskAttributes(this);
171        }
172    }
173}
